description: Drag-and-drop node reordering, hover-revealed trailing actions on each cell, and a fully custom cell editor.
A custom JTable cell editor that supports editing multi-line text directly inside the table.
Animated skeleton placeholders while search results are loading, instead of a blank screen.
A reusable tooltip component with configurable placement, so tooltips can be positioned exactly where you need them.
Custom-drawn components and simple animations built with Java's Graphics2D API.
